reading.title: Webb Reveals New Details in Supernova Remnant
reading.summary: NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope reveals the hot dust that makes up Cassiopeia A (Cas A) in this high-resolution, mid-infrared image released on Nov. 23, 2026. news.title: Metropolitan police still institutionally racist and misogynist, says report
news.summary: Independent review finds force has ‘fundamental systemic issues’ three years after damning report on Sarah Everard murder Latest review of Met police culture finds little has changed since last one The Metropolitan police remain institutionally racist, misogynistic and homophobic three years after a damning review into the force’s culture, a report has found. The investigation by Gillian Fairfield found “fundamental, systemic issues” and “institutional defensiveness” still existed in Britain’s biggest police force, which has struggled “to acknowledge racism as a structural problem”.
